entities.name: AuthResult
entities.description: What Shamel sends back when a user logs in with username and password (form POST, p. 4). It carries the session token that every other request must send, plus who the user is and which salesman they are linked to.

fields.name: success
fields.note: From the name. How a failed login is reported (success=false with HTTP 200, or HTTP 500) is not stated (ISCO-03).

fields.name: token
fields.meaning: Session token to send with every later request
fields.note: "Keep the token to send it with every request" (p. 4); sent as header `token` together with header `username` (p. 4). "Token: you could have it by call login method" (p. 2). Lifetime/expiry undocumented (ISCO-01).

fields.name: userId
fields.note: From the name.

fields.name: userCode
fields.note: From the name. Whether the `username` header must carry the login name, userCode or userId is unconfirmed (ISCO-03).

fields.name: userName
fields.note: From the name; display name vs login name not stated.

fields.name: salesmanCode
fields.note: salesmanCode → Salesman. Explains why GetCustomers returns only "the salesman's customers" unless getAll=true (p. 7). Scoping on other endpoints unknown (ISCO-25).

fields.name: userIsDisabled
fields.note: From the name. Whether a disabled user can still get a usable token is unknown (ISCO-03).

entities.business_value: Lets a tool sign in once and act as a specific Shamel user; the user's salesman link decides which customers it sees by default.

entities.name: Currency
entities.description: A currency defined in Shamel ("Get all currencies", pp. 4–5). It is the lookup list that amounts, prices and balances point to through the currency code.

fields.name: id
fields.note: From the name. Other records refer to currencies by the text code, not by this id (ISCO-28).

fields.name: code
fields.note: Join key for CurrencyRate.currency_code, Customer.currency, CustomerBalance.currency and price rows. Vouchers use codes like "NIS", "$" (p. 13), so not necessarily ISO codes (ISCO-28 b).

fields.name: currency_name
fields.note: Printed "stringcurrency_name" (missing space, p. 5).

fields.name: units
fields.meaning: Not explained; possibly the main unit name (e.g. shekel)
fields.note: ISCO-28 (a).

fields.name: division
fields.meaning: Not explained; possibly the sub-unit name (e.g. agora)
fields.note: ISCO-28 (a).

entities.business_value: Lets tools show every amount with the right currency and match vouchers, prices and balances to it.

entities.name: CurrencyRate
entities.description: An exchange-rate entry. The endpoint returns only the "latest 10 currency rate" (p. 5) with no date or currency filter, so it gives current rates, not history. Whether that is 10 in total or 10 per currency is not stated (ISCO-28 c).

fields.name: currency_code
fields.note: currency_code → Currency.code. Type printed "String" (capital S).

fields.name: rate
fields.note: From the name. Direction (base units per 1 unit of this currency?) not stated.

fields.name: date
fields.note: yyyy-MM-dd per the global date rule (p. 4).

fields.name: is_base
fields.note: From the name. Exact meaning asked in ISCO-28 (d).

entities.business_value: Lets tools convert foreign-currency balances and prices at the latest rate; historical or as-of-date rates are not available.

entities.name: Bank
entities.description: A bank defined in Shamel ("Get All Banks", p. 5; Arabic capability "سحب البنوك وفروعها", pull banks and their branches, p. 2). It identifies the bank of cheques.

fields.name: code
fields.note: Likely what VoucherCheqs.bank_code ("رقم البنك", bank number, p. 14) refers to.

fields.name: name
fields.note: From the name.

entities.business_value: Lets tools pick a valid bank when recording cheques on receipts and payments.

entities.name: BankBranch
entities.description: A branch of a bank ("Get all branchs" [sic], p. 5). The path is misspelled /Files/GetBanksBranchs; it returns all branches of all banks and cannot be filtered by bank.

fields.name: code
fields.note: Likely what VoucherCheqs.branch_code ("رقم فرع البنك", bank branch number, p. 14) refers to.

fields.name: name
fields.note: From the name.

fields.name: bank_code
fields.note: bank_code → Bank.code. Printed "stringbank_code" (missing space, p. 5).

entities.business_value: Completes cheque details (bank plus branch) for receipts and payments.

entities.name: City
entities.description: A city in Shamel's city list ("Get all cities", p. 6). Customers and vouchers point to it by number.

fields.name: id
fields.note: Customer.city, Customer(write).City ("رقم المدينة", city number, p. 9) and VoucherHeader.city (p. 13) refer to it.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Also copied into Customer.city_name.

entities.business_value: Lets tools group and filter customers by city and fill the city on new customers.

entities.name: Store
entities.description: A store (warehouse) where stock is held ("Get all stores", p. 6; Arabic capability "سحب المستودعات", pull warehouses, p. 2). The manual prints this class as `class City`, a copy-paste error; "Store" is our name for it.

fields.name: id
fields.note: Referenced by ItemStore.store, VoucherItems.store, VoucherHeader.order_store and the `store` filter header of GetItems.

fields.name: name
fields.note: From the name.

fields.name: type
fields.note: Values undocumented (ISCO-27 a, ISCO-49).

fields.name: car_code
fields.meaning: Vehicle code, probably for van (mobile sales) stores
fields.note: From the name only (ISCO-27 b).

fields.name: orgnization_code
fields.meaning: Not explained; probably an organisation or branch code
fields.note: [sic] "orgnization". ISCO-27 (c).

entities.business_value: Lets tools show stock per warehouse or van and choose the right store on orders and invoices.

entities.name: PriceClass
entities.description: One of Shamel's six named price levels ("Get the 6 price classes name", p. 6; Arabic capability "سحب فئات الاسعار", p. 2). Each customer is assigned one.

fields.name: id
fields.note: Presumably matches Item.sale_parice1..6 and Customer.price_class (ISCO-29 a).

fields.name: name
fields.note: "Get the 6 price classes name" (p. 6).

entities.business_value: Lets tools show which price list applies to a customer and label item prices by class.

entities.name: Salesman
entities.description: A sales representative (مندوب). UNDOCUMENTED: the manual prints only the heading /Files/GetSalesmen (p. 6) with no description, no inputs and no fields, and the endpoint is missing from the Arabic capability list (p. 2). Its response must come from ISCO or a live capture (ISCO-26, priority).
entities.business_value: Would let tools list salesmen and report per salesman. Salesman codes already appear in AuthResult.salesmanCode, Customer.salesman_code, Customer(write).Salesman and VoucherHeader.salesman ("رقم المندوب", salesman number, p. 13), but the list itself cannot be relied on until ISCO answers.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: A customer account as returned by /Customer/GetCustomers (pp. 6–7): identity, phone and address, salesman, price class and credit terms, tax status, GPS, and optionally balances, classifications and contacts. By default only the logged-in user's salesman's customers come back; getAll=true returns all (p. 7). Filters: lastupdatedate (changed since), code, vatreg, getStopped.

fields.name: code
fields.note: Used as the `code` filter: "to get one customer with the filled 'code'" (p. 7). Assigned by Shamel on insert (PostResponse.value, p. 9). Same key as customerCode / customer_code elsewhere.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Write field Name = "اسم الزبون" (p. 9).

fields.name: phone
fields.note: Probably from write field PhoneNumber ("تلفون 1") (ISCO-32 b).

fields.name: street
fields.note: Probably from write field Address ("الشارع") (ISCO-32 b).

fields.name: street2
fields.note: Probably from write field Street ("شارع 2") (ISCO-32 b).

fields.name: referee1
fields.meaning: Referee 1 (person who introduces or vouches for customer)
fields.note: Write field Referee = "معرف 1" (p. 9) (ISCO-32 a).

fields.name: referee2
fields.note: May hold write field RefereeMobile ("تلفون معرف 1") (ISCO-32 b).

fields.name: salesman_code
fields.note: salesman_code → Salesman. Drives default scoping: without getAll=true only "the salesman's customers" return (p. 7).

fields.name: price_class
fields.meaning: Price class assigned to the customer
fields.note: price_class → PriceClass.id. Typed double here but int in the write model (ISCO-29 c).

fields.name: credit_limit
fields.note: Sensitive. Cannot be set through /Customer/Post (ISCO-48 a).

fields.name: discount
fields.note: Percentage or amount not stated (ISCO-32 a).

fields.name: city
fields.note: city → City.id.

fields.name: currency
fields.note: currency → Currency.code.

fields.name: level
fields.note: Write field CustomerLevel = "مستوى الزبون" (p. 9). Values undocumented (ISCO-49).

fields.name: town
fields.note: Write field Town = "كود القرية" (village code, p. 9). No endpoint lists towns.

fields.name: city_name
fields.note: From the name.

fields.name: citizen_code
fields.note: ISCO-32 (a).

fields.name: attr
fields.note: Enum values unknown (ISCO-32 a, ISCO-49).

fields.name: man_name
fields.meaning: Not explained; possibly contact or responsible person's name
fields.note: ISCO-32 (a).

fields.name: trans_permissions
fields.note: ISCO-32 (a), ISCO-49.

fields.name: VATReg
fields.note: Filtered by the `vatreg` header: "to filter on vatreg field" (p. 7). Write field VatReg = "مشتغل مرخص الزبون" (p. 9).

fields.name: creditType
fields.meaning: Not explained; possibly credit or payment type
fields.note: ISCO-32 (a), ISCO-49.

fields.name: balance
fields.note: Filled only with getBalance="true" (p. 7); otherwise presumably 0, indistinguishable from a real zero (ISCO-31 a). Sensitive.

fields.name: notPayedCheqsBalance
fields.meaning: Total of the customer's cheques not yet paid
fields.note: [sic] "customer's not payed cheqs balance" (p. 7). Only with getBalance="true".

fields.name: returnedCheqsBalance
fields.meaning: Total of the customer's returned (bounced) cheques
fields.note: "customer's returned cheqs balance" (p. 7). Only with getBalance="true".

fields.name: stopped
fields.note: getStopped="true" returns "only stopped customers" (p. 7). Whether the default call includes stopped customers is unknown (ISCO-30).

fields.name: latitude
fields.note: From the name.

fields.name: longitude
fields.note: From the name.

fields.name: id_number
fields.note: Personal ID vs company registration unclear (ISCO-32 a).

fields.name: taxable
fields.note: From the name.

fields.name: paymentTermsCode
fields.note: From the name. No endpoint lists payment terms.

fields.name: classifications
fields.note: Filled only with getClassifications="true": "to return customer classifications" (p. 7). → CustomerClassificaiton [sic].

fields.name: contacts
fields.note: Filled only with getContacts="true": "to return customer's contacts" (p. 7). → CustomerContact.

entities.business_value: Gives a full customer list for CRM, route planning (GPS), credit control (limit vs balance) and incremental sync of changed customers via lastupdatedate.

entities.name: CustomerClassificaiton
entities.description: A classification tag attached to a customer (e.g. a segment or group). Returned inside Customer.classifications only when getClassifications="true" (p. 7). The class name is misspelled in the manual ("Classificaiton").

fields.name: pos
fields.meaning: Position / slot number of the classification
fields.note: From the name.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Printed on p. 8.

entities.business_value: Lets tools segment customers for reporting and targeting; no endpoint lists all possible classifications.

entities.name: CustomerContact
entities.description: A contact entry for a customer (a person, phone, email or similar). Returned inside Customer.contacts only when getContacts="true" (p. 7).

fields.name: pos
fields.note: From the name.

fields.name: name
fields.note: From the name.

fields.name: detail
fields.note: From the name.

fields.name: type
fields.note: Values undocumented (ISCO-49).

fields.name: typeName
fields.note: From the name.

entities.business_value: Gives extra phone numbers, emails and contact persons for calling or messaging customers.

entities.name: CustomerBalance
entities.description: A customer balance row ("Get list of customer balances", p. 8; Arabic capability "سحب ارصدة الزبائن", p. 2). Apparently one row per customer per currency. Empty customerCode returns all customers' balances; vatreg finds a customer by VAT number.

fields.name: code
fields.note: code → Customer.code.

fields.name: pos
fields.meaning: Not explained; possibly row or currency order
fields.note: ISCO-31 (b).

fields.name: currency
fields.note: currency → Currency.code.

fields.name: date
fields.meaning: Not explained; possibly balance or last-movement date
fields.note: ISCO-31 (b).

fields.name: balance
fields.note: Endpoint returns "customer balances" (p. 8). Sign (owed vs credit) and whether cheques/unposted vouchers are included not stated (ISCO-31 c).

fields.name: rate
fields.meaning: Exchange rate, presumably of the row's currency
fields.note: ISCO-31 (b).

entities.business_value: Lets tools show who owes what, per currency, for collections and credit control. Whether it is limited to the salesman's customers is unknown (ISCO-25).

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: The data sent to create a customer via /Customer/Post ("Insert new customer", p. 8), as a JSON string in form field `obj`. Same class name as the read model but different (PascalCase) fields; there is no customer code because Shamel assigns it and returns it in PostResponse.value (p. 9). All meanings come from Arabic comments.

fields.name: Name
fields.note: Arabic: «اسم الزبون» (p. 9). Read field: name.

fields.name: VatReg
fields.note: Arabic: «مشتغل مرخص الزبون». Printed "stringVatReg" (missing space). Read field: VATReg.

fields.name: Address
fields.note: Arabic: «الشارع», printed without "//". Probably read field street (ISCO-32 b).

fields.name: MobileNumber
fields.meaning: Fax (Arabic comment contradicts the field name)
fields.note: Arabic: «فاكس». Mobile vs fax unclear; no read counterpart (ISCO-32 c).

fields.name: PhoneNumber
fields.note: Arabic: «تلفون 1». Probably read field phone.

fields.name: Salesman
fields.meaning: Default salesman; leave empty if no salesmen exist
fields.note: Arabic: «المندوب الافتراضي – في حال عدم وجود مندوبين لا يتم تعبئته». Salesman → Salesman; read field salesman_code.

fields.name: Street
fields.note: Arabic: «شارع 2». Probably read field street2 (careful: Street is not street).

fields.name: City
fields.note: Arabic: «رقم المدينة». City → City.id.

fields.name: Town
fields.note: Arabic: «كود القرية». Read field town; no endpoint lists towns.

fields.name: Referee
fields.note: Arabic: «معرف 1». Read field referee1.

fields.name: RefereeMobile
fields.note: Arabic: «تلفون معرف 1». Possibly read field referee2 (ISCO-32 b).

fields.name: CustomerLevel
fields.note: Arabic: «مستوى الزبون». Read field level; values undocumented (ISCO-49).

fields.name: PriceClass
fields.note: Arabic: «رقم فئة السعر». PriceClass → PriceClass.id; int here, double in the read model.

entities.business_value: Lets tools (a sales app or web form) create new customers directly in Shamel. Insert-only: no update or delete; currency, credit limit and discount cannot be set (ISCO-48 a); a retried insert may create a duplicate (ISCO-43).

entities.name: PostResponse
entities.description: The JSON result of a customer or item insert ("It return the following class as Json", pp. 9 and 20): success flag, error text and the new record's code.

fields.name: Success
fields.note: From the name. Failures may also arrive as HTTP 500 with error details (p. 4) (ISCO-19).

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.meaning: Error text when the insert failed
fields.note: A single string here; the voucher Result uses string[] (p. 15).

fields.name: value
fields.meaning: Code of the newly inserted customer
fields.note: "If the process succeeded, the value will contain the inserted code of the customer" (p. 9). For /Item/Post not stated (ISCO-48 b).

entities.business_value: Confirms a new customer was created and gives its Shamel code for later orders, invoices and statements.

entities.name: CustomerPriceRow
entities.description: A special price/discount row from Customer/GetCustomerPricesAsRows (pp. 16–17, path printed without leading slash). The manual gives no class name ("CustomerPriceRow" is our name), no purpose and no inputs, only "Return the following object". The fields suggest item prices and discounts per customer or price class. Not in the Arabic capability list (p. 2).

fields.name: code
fields.meaning: Not explained; possibly row or price-list code
fields.note: ISCO-33 (c).

fields.name: price_class_name
fields.note: price_class_name → PriceClass.name. Rows with empty customer_code may be class prices (ISCO-33 e).

fields.name: customer_code
fields.note: customer_code → Customer.code.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.note: stock_code → Item.code; unconfirmed (ISCO-33 d).

fields.name: discount
fields.note: Percent or amount presumably set by discount_type.

fields.name: discount_type
fields.note: Values undocumented (ISCO-33 c, ISCO-49).

fields.name: price
fields.note: From the name.

fields.name: currency_code
fields.note: currency_code → Currency.code.

fields.name: main_unit
fields.note: From the name; printed on p. 17.

fields.name: orgnization_code
fields.meaning: Not explained; probably an organisation or branch code
fields.note: [sic] "orgnization".

fields.name: tax
fields.note: ISCO-33 (c).

entities.business_value: Would let tools quote each customer their agreed price and discount; with no documented filters each call may download the whole price table, and list-vs-single result is unclear (ISCO-33).
